name: redstamp-guarded
description: An agent whose tool calls pass through the redstamp per-call guard. The guard already blocks the worst individual calls; plumbline reads its audit log to catch the escapes composed of calls the guard individually allowed. Because redstamp records a decision per call, this is the one source where the ratchet detector (a guard denied this, then an equivalent call succeeded) is fully live. Wide capability set: the guard, not the envelope, is the first line - so keep this envelope realistic and let the sequence-level detectors do the work.
